summary: Phase 149O.20L.7O.2A.1 -- RepositoryIdentity Write-Path Remediation Proposition Independent Verification. FINAL VERDICT: INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED -- P-A' REMEDIATION PROPOSITION READY FOR HUMAN ELECTION, WITH ONE REQUIRED DISCLOSED CORRECTION. Verification-only phase; zero Dell commands issued (unlike 7O.2A, which opened a read-only Dell session -- this phase's scope was fully satisfiable from the Mac-side working tree, source-unchanged since 7O.2A's own phase-entry commit, plus 7O.2A's own already-published live-read facts). Per explicit governing instruction, no synthetic root-owned test file was created on this Mac as a stand-in for Linux sticky-bit kernel behavior; every claim in the report is tagged DIRECTLY SOURCE-VERIFIED, REFERENCE-VERIFIED FROM PRIMARY LINUX/POSIX SOURCE (not empirically executed this phase), or REPOSITORY-LOCAL/DISPOSABLE TESTED. Independently reconstructed .pcae/.gitignore's real entry count: 39, not 7O.2A's own transcribed '34' -- the omitted entry is architecture-history.json, which is simultaneously git-tracked (root-owned, part of 7O.2A's own 17-entry 'administrator-controlled' baseline) and gitignored (declared runtime-local), a direct contradiction of 7O.2A's own §3 classification for that file. Traced its producer (architecture.py's write_architecture_history_snapshot, called from pipeline.py/commands/session.py/commands/architecture.py -- the same governed hot path ensure_repository_identity sits on) and found it uses a direct truncating target.open('w') rather than the atomic mkstemp+os.replace idiom repository_identity.py uses -- so P-A''s directory-mode-only chmod 1770 fix does not cover this one artifact (its own file mode, 0640, root-owned, is unaffected by any directory-level remediation), even though it correctly covers the other 38 declared write-required artifacts (verified: agent-lock.json's exclusive-create open('x', ...) pattern IS fixed by P-A', as are all first-creation-only artifacts). This is a scope-accuracy correction to 7O.2A's election materials, not a safety objection -- P-A' remains confirmed as the minimum-safe model: reference-verified (Linux kernel check_sticky()/POSIX semantics) that the sticky bit is the sole POSIX mechanism letting pcae create new .pcae entries while blocking delete/rename/replace of all 17 root-owned governed entries (protected by two independent, stacked mechanisms: sticky bit at the directory level, and each entry's own unaffected 0640 file mode); P-B (ACL) reconfirmed redundant with P-A' on Linux (POSIX ACLs cannot separate create from delete/rename any more than plain mode bits can, confirmed directly from _acl_grants_agent_write_linux's own source); P-C (dedicated subpath) reconfirmed to relocate, not solve, the architecture-history.json gap; P-D reconfirmed rejected. Traced the idempotent-ensure name-squatting surface directly in repository_identity.py (no ownership check exists before an existing RepositoryIdentity is trusted, empirically demonstrated via a disposable tmp_path fixture test) and confirmed it is non-blocking: pre-existing to the idempotent-ensure design, not introduced or worsened by P-A', and the only real trust boundary (DeploymentBinding at /etc/pcae/hatp/trust-store) sits entirely outside .pcae/, confirmed via direct read of hatp_bootstrap.py's _LINUX_FIXED_TRUST_ROOT constant. Reconfirmed unaffected: the Protected Root, the HMIC digest (a source-file list per derive_implementation_scope_digest's own frozen-scope definition, not a .pcae-path list), and every HBDC-REQ-0xx/Class-B topology check (none targets .pcae/'s own mode, confirmed by direct source read of every registered check function). Independently confirmed the 149O.20L.7B/7B.1/7B.2/7C Boundary-P election precedent exists as real, persisted governance artifacts in this working tree (docs files plus the git-tracked authority-evaluation template), not merely by trusting 7O.2A's characterization. Also disclosed, non-blocking: no consumer module besides repository_identity.py performs symlink rejection before reading its own runtime-local path (a pre-existing defense-in-depth gap, not introduced by P-A'). No Dell mutation, no RepositoryIdentity, no DeploymentBinding, no election, no CHGR this phase. Fast Green re-run in full and independently confirmed via a live git stash -u/pop A/B comparison: 257 failed/9 errors reproduce identically with and without this phase's changes present, confirming zero regressions.
